EN.Main Heading/Slogan: More than an invitation, it's a memory
EN.Intro Paragraph: We offer unique, modern, and beautiful digital invitation cards to make your special day even more amazing.
EN.Service Description 1: We beautifully design invitation cards viewable on mobile phones and computers with modern Theme options.
EN.Service Description 2: Include Pre-Wedding images and short videos to give guests a new experience and memory.
EN.Service Description 3: Manage guest lists and responses easily through our system and receive clear reports.
EN.Testimonial Quote 1: “The digital invitation card is very easy to send, and guests loved having the Pre-Wedding video included. The service is fast and efficient!”
EN.Testimonial Quote 2: “The Google Map feature is very important because my guests found the location easily. Thank you, Digital Invite!”
